input.summary:
Cart passage lit: one hanging lantern at (35,9,8) under the passage ceiling (y10) added to parts/room-10.mjs build(g). Floor light min 7 to 8, 0 dim and 0 dark cells across all 140 floor cells.
Room check says OK, walk unchanged, mcd check reports no unsupported hanging blocks. make.sh rebuilt build.nbt.
Only room-10.mjs was edited; no furniture, walls or doors touched.
left: The module's header comment still says 'no ceiling block to hang from here' and that the passage is lit only by standing lanterns. That is now stale: the passage has a ceiling at y10 and a hanging lantern at (35,9,8). Left unedited because the header is the designer's text; the designer should update it.
Hidden-light and mood choices were not revisited; the lantern is a plain hanging lantern, consistent with the cart passage's existing standing lanterns.

waste.what: Trial-and-error to find which lamp cell fixed the two dim floor cells (x35, z13..14 at light 7). I relied on the room tool's single suggested spot and then re-ran the whole build to confirm.
waste.cost: 2 rebuilds + 1 failed sed edit (shell quoting) + 1 re-edit
waste.tool: `mcd room --only` could take `--try x,y,z` to report the light map for a candidate lamp cell without touching the module, or print the exact cell each suggested lamp lifts (currently it only says 'lifts 2 cells to 8+').

waste.what: Writing the lantern into the module by hand: the legend-plus-layers form needed the hanging state inline, which I had to work out.
waste.tool: A lamp helper in the vocabulary, e.g. lampAt(g, x, y, z, { hang: true }), that places a lantern with hanging state set from whether the cell above is solid.

companions.task: Update the cart passage header comment so it no longer says there is no ceiling to hang from; the passage now has a hanging lantern at (35,9,8) under the y10 ceiling.
